name: PVRBench
description: PVRBench is a benchmark that injects real-world perturbations such as weather, occlusion, and camera motion into embodied video datasets to assess the accuracy and reasoning quality of vision-language models under realistic disturbances.
reputation: A niche but useful robustness benchmark for embodied video reasoning, with growing interest in evaluating VLMs under realistic perturbations.
notes: Focuses on robustness evaluation of video reasoning models under real-world perturbations.
